chunks: And I ask Allah through the extent of His mercy and the greatness of His power in granting every desire,

that He may grant me and you success in that which brings His pleasure, namely, steadfastness upon the clear excuse/plea to Him and to His creatures, with good praise among the people, and beautiful effect in the land, and completion of the blessing, and multiplication of the honor,
and that He may end for me and you with happiness and martyrdom. Surely, we are desirous of Him.
And peace be upon the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family (and grant peace), the pure, the chaste; and grant peace with abundant peace. And peace.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali pray for Malik al-Ashtar regarding his governance?
ai.summary: This supplication serves as the spiritual conclusion to Imam Ali’s (AS) detailed administrative instructions, emphasizing that political authority must be rooted in divine pleasure and clear justification (al-'udh al-wadih) before both God and the populace. It highlights the dual goal of effective governance—manifested through praise and lasting impact—and the ultimate reward of happiness or martyrdom, reflecting the Shia ideal of the just ruler who remains accountable to the Divine. The invocation underscores the continuity between earthly administration and eternal destiny, a core theme in Nahj al-Balagha's political theology.

en.sayed-ali-raza: I ask Allāh through the extent of His mercy and the greatness of His power of giving a good inclination

that He may prompt me and you to advance a clear plea before Him and His creatures in a manner that may attract His pleasure along with handsome praise among the people, good effect in the country, an increase in prosperity and a hightening of honour;
and that He may allow me and you to die a death of virtue and martyrdom. Surely, we have to return to Him.
Peace be on the Messenger of Allāh — may Allāh shower His blessings and plentiful salutation on him and his pure and chaste descendants; and that is an end to the matter.
